schedules.name: Morning Social Posts
schedules.prompt: It's time for your morning posting session. First, query your recent decisions: tools/db_query.sh --table agent_decisions --eq agent:social --limit 5. Then check what you've already posted today: tools/db_query.sh --table social_posts --gte posted_at:TODAY. Post 3 items to X and Facebook using hooks from content_engine.md — vary the hooks and platforms. After each post, log it: tools/db_insert.sh --table social_posts --data '{...}'. Log your session summary to agent_decisions. Report what you posted to this channel.

schedules.name: Midday Social Posts
schedules.prompt: Midday posting session. Check what you've posted today: tools/db_query.sh --table social_posts --gte posted_at:TODAY. Post 2-3 items across X, Facebook, and Instagram — avoid repeating hooks or platforms from this morning. Log each post to social_posts and summarize in agent_decisions. Report what you posted.

schedules.name: Evening Social Posts
schedules.prompt: Evening posting session. Check today's posts: tools/db_query.sh --table social_posts --gte posted_at:TODAY. Post 2-3 items — focus on engagement-optimized content and any platforms underrepresented today. Log each post to social_posts and summarize in agent_decisions. Report what you posted.

schedules.name: Nurture Email Check
schedules.prompt: Daily nurture check. Query leads in nurture pipeline: tools/db_query.sh --table leads --eq nurture_status:nurture --order last_email_at:asc --limit 20. For leads whose last_email_at is more than 2 days ago, advance their nurture_step and send the next email in the sequence from email_engine.md. After sending, update the lead: tools/db_update.sh --table leads --eq id:<id> --set nurture_step:<next> --set last_email_at:<now>. Log your session to agent_decisions. Report how many leads you processed and emails sent.

schedules.name: Lead Discovery
schedules.prompt: Scheduled lead discovery run. First check recent decisions: tools/db_query.sh --table agent_decisions --eq agent:leads --limit 5. Run tools/scrape_leads.sh --max-pages 3 to discover new contacts. Evaluate each contact using the Lead Discovery Workflow — validate name, role, organization, and email quality. Insert validated leads with tools/lead_insert.sh. Log your discovery session to agent_decisions with context including associations scraped and validation stats. Report your results: scraped count, validated count, rejected reasons.

schedules.name: Weekly Growth Experiment Review
schedules.prompt: Weekly experiment review. Query running experiments: tools/db_query.sh --table experiments --eq status:running. Query recent social post performance: tools/db_query.sh --table social_posts --limit 20. Review each running experiment — if enough data, mark completed with outcome: tools/db_update.sh --table experiments --eq id:<id> --set status:completed --set outcome:<result>. Then propose 1-2 new experiments and log them: tools/db_insert.sh --table experiments --data '{...}'. Log your review to agent_decisions. Report findings and next experiments.

schedules.name: Weekly Admin Report
schedules.prompt: Weekly cross-agent report. Compile metrics from all tables: tools/db_query.sh --table social_posts --gte posted_at:LAST_WEEK --count. tools/db_query.sh --table emails --gte created_at:LAST_WEEK --count. tools/db_query.sh --table leads --gte created_at:LAST_WEEK --count. tools/db_query.sh --table experiments --eq status:running. tools/db_query.sh --table agent_decisions --gte created_at:LAST_WEEK --limit 30. Also run tools/ga_report.sh --metric sessions,totalUsers,screenPageViews --days 7. Compile a concise weekly summary: posts made, emails sent, leads discovered, experiments status, website traffic. Post the report to this channel using the weekly_report.json template via slack_post.sh.
